analysis.reasonEn: Previous buy signal held for 4 consecutive sessions. RSI slightly declined from 58.2 to 56.9 but remains in the upper neutral zone. MACD histogram improved from -0.4561 to 1.3429, signaling bullish expansion. Volume is subdued at 0.54x the 5-day average, but the price is forming a Higher Low within the uptrend channel, defending the $194.60 support. Trading above SMA200 by 4.11% maintains medium-to-long term trend strength.
